description: Change a post. Content changes make a new version, and anything already approved or scheduled goes back to the approval queue (with whoami auto_approve, post_submit approves your edit again). Published targets are never changed. Title, series_id (null to take it out of its series), episode and timezone change without re-approval. Changing timezone alone keeps each scheduled moment; to keep the clock time in the new zone, call post_schedule with a scheduled_at without an offset and the timezone.

episode.description: Only to override the episode number.

highlight_ids.description: Stories: the Highlight each Instagram account files it in (see highlights_list); [] clears them.

hook_seconds.description: With script: how long its opening line runs in the video, in seconds

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

kind.description: reel, trial_reel (Instagram), image, carousel, video, story (Instagram: one photo or video, no caption), or text (Threads, Facebook, LinkedIn, Bluesky, Mastodon and Google Business Profile: words only, no media; a link in a LinkedIn or Bluesky text post shows as a card)

network.description: Edit only this network's version of the post (a platform from the post's accounts); the other networks' approvals stay. Leave out to edit the post itself, which sends every network back for approval

network_kinds.description: One post, mixed formats: the format each network takes when it isn't kind, keyed by network, e.g. {instagram:"reel", facebook:"reel", youtube:"reel", threads:"video", tiktok:"video"} or {threads:"text"} (words only, no media for that network). Each network must take its format. null takes a network back to kind. All accounts stay on one post

script.description: The recorder's prompter script, when the video was read from one: its first line is the post's hook (how it opens, for insights_get hooks). Not kept.

series_id.description: Series from series_list; the post gets the next episode number.

timezone.description: The post's own time zone (IANA, e.g. Asia/Tokyo) for a post that should go out at a clock time somewhere else; null follows the workspace's. Left out, it stays as it is (a new post follows the workspace).

title.description: Internal name. Defaults to the caption's start.

name: post_update
title: Edit a post
